Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level in the United States has been much higher than at the University of Copenhagen. While I do like that the only thing you need to do in order to pass courses in Pol Sci I Copenhagen, is finish your exam, this really doesn't create the best circumstances for academic development. I found here, people are more dedicated, more ambitious, more engaged and younger!. All my professors has been brilliant, and they actually engage with students.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Look above. I think the academic level in Copenhagen is so high, but the students are by no means held accountable for their development. With the progression of AI, the exams forms need to be changed heavily in Copenhagen, as of now it is quite embarrassing to be completely honest. At UCI, I've had countless midterms, quizzes and exams written in hand, as well as physical presentations. There is hardly any of that in Copenhagen, which I find not only odd, but insufficient
